semantic_rules: old and new package-witness pairs independently verify and name the same Account
new authority revision is strictly greater than old authority revision
every old revocation remains present verbatim in the new authority snapshot
every old conversation membership remains at the same or a greater revision and never loses an old member
every old Device certificate remains byte-identical or its Device is explicitly revoked in the new authority snapshot
old and new recovery roster digests differ
epoch zero requires a zero previous transition ID; later epochs require a nonzero previous transition ID
request lifetime is positive and at most 1800 seconds
each approval binds the exact request, epochs, previous transition, both rosters, challenge and expiry
each approver is an active Device in the old roster, the new roster or both
certificate approvals are strictly ordered and distinct by Device ID
joint quorum requires floor(old-count/2)+1 old approvals and floor(new-count/2)+1 new approvals
one Device present in both rosters counts once toward each roster
caller checks account, old epoch, old roster digest and previous transition ID against a local DB-authenticated monotonic anchor
